items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: the group that I was involved with was Phil Woods, Kenny Dorham, Al Cohn and myself

ctx.x: Yeah, I’ll sell this to you if you want.

You know that particular album, doing Al Cohn’s thing, is because in ‘56, the year before, we worked together with the Bird Land All Stars. We went out tour for ten weeks, what a show. I mean the group that I was involved with was Phil Woods, Kenny Dorham, Al Cohn and myself, and it was like a west coast, we had a west coast rhythm section. And it was a little band and we recorded that. But on that show they had the Basie band, Joe Williams, Al Hibbler, Sarah Vaughan, Lester Young, who did two or three numbers…
